fixes.name: Security dependencies
fixes.result: Patched isolated owner dependencies and transitive fast-uri versions; installed candidate npm audit reports zero advisories. Original Dad packages preserved.

fixes.name: Session renewal
fixes.result: Exact owner request sessions propagate validated credential rotations and return replacement cookies. Detached preparation uses fresh non-renewing authority; intentional logout remains successful. Concurrent rotation, stale incoming cookies and revocation remain checked. Default runtime path is unchanged.

fixes.name: Audio lifecycle
fixes.result: Owner build stops cleanly if audio suspends/interruption closes its clock or a microphone track ends; releases resources and offers a clear restart message without acknowledging unheard playback. Default client behavior and Heart unchanged.

fixes.name: Safe verification build
fixes.result: npm run check ends with build:check into ignored .local/check-build. Production build remains a separate explicit operation; installation in the shared live checkout is documented as deployment-sensitive.

fixes.name: Migration replay guard
fixes.result: Historical initializer requires --initialize-empty, checks every target before writes, and refuses populated/application-object targets. Established-database instructions point to the guarded additive upgrader.

fixes.name: Asana recovery identity
fixes.result: Explicit encrypted format-3 owner backup retains nonsecret import mappings and receipts atomically with care records. OAuth credentials/sessions excluded; ordinary formats1/2 unchanged. Restore requires an isolated empty disconnected target; reconnect/replay cannot create another copy.

fixes.name: Safari sample attribution
fixes.result: New speech from listening or idle-grace closing is bound to the selected scenario; preparation cannot relabel that turn and opening observations remain separate.

historical_failures: The npm lockfile-only operation unexpectedly rewrote hidden installed-tree metadata, while installed package code stayed unchanged. The preservation guard caught it; the metadata was reconstructed and restored to the exact initial SHA-256 before all package installation moved to the isolated owner release. Failed regression fixtures and the detached-preparation before-repair401 remain private; no Dad restart or package code replacement occurred.
remaining: Physical microphone permission, actual iPhone/Safari speech capture, human audibility and genuine-day/full-slice acceptance remain open. These fixes do not mark those gates complete.
Dad intentionally retains the prior deployed code/packages until a separate promotion decision.
The actual SQL recovery probe used a synthetic provider; no production Asana writeback/consent/identity gate is inferred.
private_evidence_ref: Ignored owner maintenance bundle: exact full tests/typecheck/build/audit, pinned source manifest and active-entry proof, original page backups, read-only care/config/assets/package hashes, actual PostgreSQL probe and verified cleanup, and bounded numeric request accounting. No credential, transcript, raw care payload or provider identifier published.
